name: Alibi: The Dinner Party
source:
Play as a Police Detective investigating a murder at a luxurious villa. When your old friend Jasmine Lee becomes the prime suspect, it's up to you to reveal the truth. Navigate a gripping case filled with twists and turns that'll leave you guessing until the very end.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2540420/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名警探，调查豪华别墅中的谋杀案。当你的老朋友李茉莉成为头号嫌疑人时，你就需要揭露真相了。探索一个充满曲折的扣人心弦的案件，直到最后你都在猜测。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2540420/]Steam[/url]]
